title: MCP Server
description: Connect AI agents to this project over the Model Context Protocol. An agent sees what its API key allows.
offForTeam: MCP is off for the team {team}.
offForProject: The team {team} has MCP on, but this project is off.
askManager: Ask a team owner or manager to turn it on:
keyHint: Create a key on the API keys page, then replace {apiKey} in the snippet.

notes.claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop connects to remote servers through the mcp-remote bridge. Needs Node.js.
notes.other: Any client that supports MCP over Streamable HTTP works. Point it at the endpoint. Send an Authorization: Bearer {apiKey} header.

oauth.description: Use this for any MCP client that supports OAuth, such as ChatGPT or Claude. You sign in with your Itsaplan account. The client never receives an API key.

steps.add: Add an MCP app in your client.
steps.choose: Choose OAuth when the client asks how to sign in.
steps.signIn: Sign in to Itsaplan and approve access.

oauth.security: OAuth uses PKCE (S256), dynamic client registration, and access tokens scoped to your Itsaplan account.

consent.title: Authorize Itsaplan
consent.description: Allow this MCP client to act with the permissions of your Itsaplan account.
consent.missingCode: This authorization request is missing its consent code.
